images.title: Two half circles on AB
images.purpose: Show two equal half circles on a line AB of 8 cm, one above and one below, each with radius 2 cm.
images.composition: A horizontal line AB centred with the wave of two half circles above and below, wide margins.
images.exact_structure: Horizontal grey #6B7280 line AB of 8 cm with A at left and B at right. Point X halfway, 4 cm from A. Upper half circle in teal #0072B2 on the flat side AX (4 cm, so radius 2 cm) above AB. Lower half circle in amber #E69F00 on the flat side XB (4 cm, radius 2 cm) below AB. Exactly 2 half circles, equal in size.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
half circles that cross past A, X or B
images.takeaway: The flat side of each half circle is 4 cm, so the compass opening is 2 cm.
images.description: A line AB of 8 cm with its middle X, a teal half circle above on AX and an amber half circle below on XB, each with a 2 cm radius.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the flat side of one half circle and say the opening needed.

image_decisions.why: The wave of two equal half circles is the single picture for this construction.
